claim_scope: Development-only, fixed-geometry diagnostic of whether residual CHA-GB polar mismatch co-varies with electrostatic heterogeneity on a deterministic solvent-accessible-surface proxy. This is not a first-shell-water measurement, an actual GB/PB dielectric boundary, an energy correction, a force model, endpoint selection, ranking certification, or an accuracy claim.

mathematical_invariants.atom_relabeling: A,Phi2,Fn2,Gamma_n unchanged when positions, charges, and radii are permuted together
mathematical_invariants.charge_inversion: A,Phi2,Fn2 unchanged and Gamma_n changes sign
mathematical_invariants.charge_scaling: Phi2 and Fn2 scale as abs(lambda); Gamma_n scales as sign(lambda); A is unchanged
mathematical_invariants.proper_rotation: exact continuum descriptors are invariant; finite directional quadrature is required only to satisfy the frozen numerical stability gate

surface_definition.accessibility_rule: point x_ik is accessible iff ||x_ik-R_j||^2 >= a_j^2-tau for every j != i
surface_definition.interpretation: Union boundary of atom-centered spheres expanded by a 1.4-A probe. It is a SAS proxy, not a solvent-excluded reentrant surface, an explicit-water first shell, or the actual CHA-GB/PBSA dielectric boundary.
surface_definition.name: deterministic-fibonacci-shrake-rupley-sas-proxy
